title: New strategy for comprehensive utilization of aerogels prepared from fly ash
content:
Abstract

Fly ash, as a major by-product generated during the combustion process of coal-fired power plants, occupies an important position in the field of renewable resources due to its chemical composition, annual production and cumulative stock. This study develops a high value-added utilization route for fly ash-based aerogels, which aims to maximize the resource utilization of fly ash by integrating multiple chemical processes. As-designed aerogel exhibits superior thermal insulation and hydrophobicity, with a thermal conductivity of only 0.043 W·(m·K)−1 and a high contact angle of 133°. The residual acid leaching residue is separated by simple water washing to obtain industrial salt. Finally, the insoluble residue is used as a catalyst support to construct a CuCe-based catalyst for CO oxidation. As-prepared CuCe-based catalyst shows good catalytic activity for CO oxidation, achieving 99.9% CO conversion at 130°C. This novel strategy fully realizes the high-value comprehensive utilization of fly ash and provides a new idea for solid waste treatment.
